[SWS_CM_10320] Transport protocol for sending of a SOME/IP event message
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00204, RS_CM_00201, RS_SOMEIP_00004, RS_SOMEIP_-
00009, RS_SOMEIP_00010
⌈
The SOME/IP event message shall be transmitted using
UDP
if the threshold de-
fined by the
multicastThreshold
attribute of the
SomeipProvidedEventGroup
that is aggregated by the
ProvidedSomeipServiceInstance
in the role
event-
Group
in the Manifest has been reached (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00134]). The
SOME/IP event message shall be transmitted using the transport protocol defined
by the attribute
SomeipServiceInterfaceDeployment
.
fieldDeployment
.
no-
tifier
.
transportProtocol
in the Manifest if this threshold has not been reached
(see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00802]).
⌋
